name: Mochins
description: Mochins is a 4,000-piece collection of looping vinyl-toy mochi PFP GIFs on Shape. Each figure is stacked from six layers — stage, haze, vinyl, face, topping, and steam — then flattened onto one 16-frame GIF. Gloss plastic. Tight spec. Clear coat. No outlines. Collector-shelf light. The vinyl idles.
